purpose: Proposed environment-only gameplay preview based on existing game sprites and HUD; not an implemented screenshot.

input_images.role: edit target; current HUD, hero and three insect enemies retained

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: One believable in-game environment design preview for B02 L09, based on the CURRENT game screenshot. This is a proposed visual preview, not a claim of implemented gameplay.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: current 1280 x 720 gameplay screenshot. Input image 2 is ONLY an ENVIRONMENT STYLE REFERENCE, specifically its L09 molting-garden panel and natural scene edges. Do not reproduce the second image as a board. Output one full-screen 16:9 gameplay view at the same framing as image 1.
Preserve the current screenshot's exact HUD structure, positions, scale and wording: Luo Zhan portrait and upper-left life/anger panel; upper-center expedition progress strip; upper-right route and gold buttons; center directional map-distance tag; right-side L09 task parchment; lower-left thunder-charge panel; bottom circular skill badges, labels, key hints and Tab button. Preserve current life 203/203, anger 20/100, Lv.1, expedition 2/6, gold 0 and task state. No redesign of the HUD and no changed skill mechanics.
Identity invariants: keep the SAME existing melee player body, orange-red costume, hand-held axe and pose at approximately center [643,331], matching the existing top-left portrait. Keep the SAME three existing colorful insect monster sprites and proportions: orange hard-shell bug at [404,230], green long-legged bug at [900,248], green-winged guard at [870,444], with their health bars and level captions. Do not invent new monsters, replace them with large concept-art creatures or move them into a different screenshot. Keep the existing blue crystal beacon near [277,390] and violet crystal beacon near [803,550], reusing their current brass bases and sprite scale.
Change ONLY the environmental world underneath this retained gameplay layer: replace the visibly repetitive tiled floor and generic random prop scatter with an authored L09 molting-ceremony garden composition. Use the current game's amber egg nests, insect-silk supply coffers / leaf-sail supply carts, short classical pillar-arch motifs and current beacons as the reuse baseline. Remove BOTH industrial cable winches entirely. Preserve the existing supply-cart silhouette at upper right, but present it as a deliberately parked amber-and-leaf insect-civilization prop rather than part of a repeated random scatter.
The central combat floor remains broad, complete, dry and traversable. Ground is low-contrast warm honey-cream stone and naturally varied beeswax fragments with small irregular seams, light pollen grass and sparse delicate leaf veins near the edges. No mirrored repeating cracks, stretched texture strips, huge rectangular pool, tall slab wall, maze or continuous opaque obstruction.
Hand-authored composition: place two small amber egg-nest objective props along the upper-left and upper-right garden margins, well off the player route, consistent with the task counter. A broad diagonal open route connects the left-upper entry to the right-lower exit around the retained three enemies. A flower-like treasure coffer and existing insect-silk supply prop cluster sit in the far upper-right side lane. Existing short pillar and leafy arches frame the left entry and far right exit at small sprite scale.
Add ONLY a small amount of new thematic architecture for this proposed design: an empty translucent molted-shell display rack along the upper-center back edge; two light violet insect-wing curtains along the outer side edges; a giant green leaf canopy at the upper outside corner. These are the assets to be created later, not a whole new unimplemented civilization set.
Design the visible edges completely: softly curving low honeycomb-beeswax terrace rims, pollen flowers, giant leaves, amber root bases and sunlit hive-valley scenery beyond the playable floor. Hard ground blends through small stone/wax fragments, grass and flowers into the low terrace rim. No grey empty border, abrupt square tilemap cutoff or high texture-stretched wall. Background extends to every image edge. Foreground leaves are soft and restricted to lower corners; leave skill HUD, monsters and player unobscured.
Style: bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy 2.5D, warm afternoon sun from upper left, fresh honey yellow / light leaf green / vivid violet accents, consistent clean colored linework and the same high-angle three-quarter near-isometric perspective as the current game and reference. Props keep believable game-sprite scale rather than towering over the actor. Maintain clear visual hierarchy and calm floor detail.
Avoid: changed portrait, changed hero, changed enemy species or proportions, new skill icons, new UI layout, changed player status, extra enemies, new monsters, giant concept-art queen, winches, steel cable coils, grey outside void, darkness, gore, rectangular water hole, long walls, stretched art, random repeated props, clutter on the center route, a multi-panel collage, labels announcing new features, watermark.
